apps.localizedDescription: Camlo（开幕）是一款零门槛 iOS / iPadOS 原生 Core Animation (.tendies / CAML) 动态与滑动变身锁屏制作工坊。内置 120Hz 原生 `.ca` 实时交互试穿、陀螺仪 3D 裸眼视差 (ParameterizedCA)、昼夜双生壁纸 (appearanceAware)、智能时钟配色字体与主屏柔焦配套、6 套内置获奖风光双态预设与 70 套零体积馆藏大师级官方云端壁纸、8 款异形粒子与体积流光特效、AI 主体抠图遮挡时钟、视频/实况抽帧无缝循环与免电脑一键直写 iOS 26 / iOS 27 锁屏画廊。

versions.localizedDescription:
## Camlo v1.3.3 (Build 26)

### 修复 SideStore / AltStore 个人免费 Apple ID 安装失败 (#6)
- **修复 `appIdName` 非法字符报错**：感谢 `@linszx` 的精准定位！此前主 `Info.plist` 顶层 `CFBundleDisplayName` 设为 `"开幕 Camlo"`，导致 SideStore / AltStore（底层 `SideSign` / `AltSign`）在向苹果开发者接口 `addAppId` 注册 App ID 时因包含中文及空格而触发 `An invalid value '开幕 Camlo' was provided for the parameter 'appIdName'` 安装失败。
- **纯 ASCII 顶层名称 + 原生 `InfoPlist.strings` 本地化**：现已将主 `Info.plist` 顶层 `CFBundleDisplayName` 与 `apps.json` `name` 统一改为纯 ASCII 的 `"Camlo"`，同时启用 `LSHasLocalizedDisplayName` 并通过 `InfoPlist.xcstrings` 生成 `zh-Hans.lproj/InfoPlist.strings` 与 `en.lproj/InfoPlist.strings`——SideStore / AltStore 个人免费签可顺利完成 App ID 注册并保留 `App Group` 权限，简体中文桌面图标仍优雅显示为 **「开幕 Camlo」**。
- 完整继承 `v1.3.2` 对 iPhone Duo 折叠屏 `retinaMultiplier` 与内屏偏移的修复、10 套原创「次元 3D」二次元交互云端包与金库旧包自动原地自愈。

### Fix SideStore / AltStore Free Apple ID Installation Failure (#6)
- **Fixed `appIdName` Validation Error**: Thanks to `@linszx` for the detailed root-cause report! SideStore / AltStore pass the top-level `Info.plist` `CFBundleDisplayName` directly to Apple's `addAppId` Developer Portal API, which rejects non-ASCII characters (`"开幕 Camlo"`).
- **Pure ASCII Bundle Display Name + Localized `InfoPlist.strings`**: Top-level `CFBundleDisplayName` and `apps.json` `name` are now `"Camlo"`, while `zh-Hans.lproj/InfoPlist.strings` (via `InfoPlist.xcstrings` + `LSHasLocalizedDisplayName = true`) preserves the localized Chinese Home Screen label (`"开幕 Camlo"`). Free Apple ID sideloading via SideStore / AltStore now registers seamlessly with `App Group` entitlements preserved.
- Includes all `v1.3.2` iPhone Duo scaling/centering fixes, 10 official 3D Anime Cloud packs, and automatic Vault self-healing.

> ⚠️ **iOS Compatibility Reminder**: On-device Computer-Free Direct Write supports **iOS / iPadOS 26.0 – 27.3 beta 1** (Apple patched `worse_query` in `27.3 beta 2`). Creation, 120Hz preview, and `.tendies` export continue to work on all versions.

## Camlo v1.3.2 (Build 25)

### 修复 iPhone Duo（折叠屏）所有壁纸缩小为 1/3 与展开内屏偏移问题 (#4)
- **彻底修复缩放比例 (`retinaMultiplier: 3 → 1`)**：在 `WallpaperKit` `<wallpapers>` 多屏描述中，由于 Camlo 以逻辑点坐标（外屏 `466×678`、内屏 `951×669`）编译底层 Core Animation 图层树，将其 `retinaMultiplier` 设为 `3` 会导致系统 `WKParameterizedCAPackageLoader` 将绘制尺寸再除以 `3`，从而把壁纸缩小为约 `1/3`（实测 `951×669` px）；现已修正为 `retinaMultiplier = 1` 并保留完整物理像素资源。
- **修复展开内屏居中偏移 (`BACKGROUND_INNER` / `FLOATING_INNER` position 对齐)**：在折叠屏展开状态下，`WKParameterizedCAWallpaperRepresentedView` 会将 `BACKGROUND_INNER` / `FLOATING_INNER` 直接挂入外屏 `__capRootLayer__` 的 `hostingLayer`（中心点 `233 339`），旧版 `475.5 334.5` 坐标会导致向右下角明显偏移；现统一对齐为 `233 339`，实现外屏/内屏严丝合缝全屏铺满。
- **Duo 导出分辨率升级**：外屏素材采样升级至原生 `@3x`（`1398×2034`），展开内屏升级至高清（`2282×1606`）；10 套官方云端 iPhone Duo 双屏壁纸（`18951`–`18960`）已全量重新编译并通过 `CAPackage` 渲染校验。
- **金库旧包自动原地自愈 + 120Hz 实时预览居中修复**：升级至 `v1.3.2` 后，已下载或自制保存在金库的旧版 Duo `.tendies` 包会在后台与写入瞬间自动原地修复（无需重新下载或重新创作，只需重新点击一次**「一键应用到锁屏」**并注销即可满屏生效）；同时修复应用内 `120Hz` 实时预览外/内屏定位。

### Fix iPhone Duo 1/3 Shrunk Scaling & Off-Center Inner Screen (#4)
- **Fixed `retinaMultiplier` (`3 → 1`)**: `CAMLCompiler` authors Duo root layers in logical points (`466×678` Outer, `951×669` Inner); changing `<wallpapers>` `retinaMultiplier` from `3` to `1` stops `WallpaperKit` from shrinking the rendered wallpaper to `1/3` size while keeping full-resolution texture assets (`1398×2034` Outer `@3x`, `2282×1606` Inner).
- **Fixed Unfolded Inner-Screen Offset**: Aligned `BACKGROUND_INNER` / `FLOATING_INNER` layer `position` to `__capRootLayer__` center (`233 339`) so `WKParameterizedCAWallpaperRepresentedView`'s `hostingLayer` fills `(0, 0, 951, 669)` edge-to-edge on unfold.
- **Recompiled All 10 Official Cloud Duo Packs (`18951`–`18960`)**: Verified via `CAPackage` & simulated `WallpaperKit` layout bounds.
- **Automatic Vault Self-Healing & Accurate Live Preview**: Existing downloaded or Studio-created Duo packs in your Vault heal automatically in-place upon updating to `v1.3.2` — just tap **1-Tap Apply** again and respring (or re-download from Cloud Gallery for crisp `1398×2034` / `2282×1606` assets).

> ⚠️ **iOS Compatibility Reminder**: On-device Computer-Free Direct Write supports **iOS / iPadOS 26.0 – 27.3 beta 1** (Apple patched `worse_query` in `27.3 beta 2`). Creation, 120Hz preview, and `.tendies` export continue to work on all versions.

## What's New in Camlo v1.3.1 (Build 24)

### 1. 10 Original 「次元 3D (Anime 3D)」 Cloud Wallpapers (`ParameterizedCA` + Apple Vision Clock Depth)
- Official zero-bloat Cloud Gallery (`wallpapers/`) expanded from 60 to **70 packs** (**395+ total** across Official + Community channels), while keeping `Camlo_v1.3.1_Bilingual.ipa` ultra-slim at **~9.5 MB (`9.1 MiB`)**.
- All 10 new 100%-original Anime packs (`18961`–`18970`) are natively compiled as single-screen **`ParameterizedCA` (`Marble` / `wantsDeviceMotion = true`)** bundles with **real hardware 120Hz 3D Gyroscope Parallax**, **Apple Vision foreground cutouts occluding the `09:41` clock**, **3-state (`Sleep → Locked → Unlock`) morphing**, and **hardware `CAEmitterLayer` / volumetric particles**:
  1. `18961` · **墨线初醒 · 樱绘少女** (*Ink Sketch Bloom · Sakura*) — Obsidian ink sketch blooming into full color & drifting sakura
  2. `18962` · **赛博视界 · 瞳孔开机** (*Cyber Visor · Wake Protocol*) — Standby cyber courier awakening cyan/magenta visor rings
  3. `18963` · **雨岸平交道 · 破云霞光** (*Rainy Crossing · Sunbreak*) — Coastal rain clearing into amber cumulonimbus sunbeams
  4. `18964` · **狐面鸟居 · 千灯夜祭** (*Kitsune Torii · Lantern Festival*) — Midnight shrine igniting vermilion-gold lanterns & maple sparks
  5. `18965` · **猩红爵士 · 破屏切入** (*Crimson Velvet · Cut-In*) — Monochrome phantom erupting into crimson & gold-leaf graphic cut-in
  6. `18966` · **天台星镜 · 流星夜话** (*Rooftop Observatory · Meteors*) — Twilight refractor telescope awakening Milky Way & meteor shower
  7. `18967` · **深夜窗猫 · 暖灯可可** (*Midnight Desk · Cat & Cocoa*) — Cool moonlit Lo-Fi study switching on honey-amber lamp light
  8. `18968` · **星穹魔女 · 古铜星盘** (*Astral Witch · Celestial Astrolabe*) — Silver-braided witch awakening molten-gold celestial rings & butterflies
  9. `18969` · **格纳库整备 · 光翼出击** (*Orbital Hangar · Wing Ignition*) — Titanium mecha standby igniting emerald optics & azure plasma wings
  10. `18970` · **松崖剑意 · 破晓青莲** (*Cliff Pine Swordswoman · Lotus Dawn*) — Moonlit swordswoman awakening golden cloud-sea dawn & jade lotus aura

### 2. Cloud Gallery `Anime 3D` Category & Scrollable Pill Filter
- Adds dedicated **`次元 3D / Anime 3D`** filter chip and upgrades the Cloud Gallery filter bar to a horizontal scrollable pill row with live pack counters.

> ⚠️ **iOS Compatibility Reminder**: On-device Computer-Free Direct Write supports **iOS / iPadOS 26.0 – 27.3 beta 1** (Apple patched `worse_query` in `27.3 beta 2`). Creation, 120Hz preview, and `.tendies` export continue to work on all versions.

## What's New in Camlo v1.3.0

### 📱 Native iPhone Duo Dual-Screen Canvas (Inner + Outer)
- Compiles unified WallpaperKit `<wallpapers>` `ParameterizedCA` packages embedding both the **Outer Cover** (`466×678` pt) and **Inner Unfolded Landscape** (`951×669` pt) canvases with `requiresLandscapeScaling = true`, scaled gyro parallax, and synchronized `Sleep / Locked / Unlock` transitions.
- Auto-detects **iPhone Duo (`iPhone19,4`)** and switches Slide-to-Morph Studio & Video Studio to dual-screen mode by default (with manual toggle available on every iPhone).
- Interactive **Outer / Inner live preview switcher**, landscape crop guides, dual Vision AI foreground clock-depth cutouts, and 120Hz `.ca` preview support in Vault X-Ray.

### 🎨 10 Exclusive iPhone Duo Official Cloud Packs (60 Official · 385+ Total)
- Added a dedicated **iPhone Duo** category in Cloud Gallery with **10 bespoke museum-grade Inner+Outer packs** (8 Dual-Screen Depth Morph + 2 Dual-Screen Living Cinemagraphs) hosted outside the IPA for zero app bloat (~9.1 MB IPA).
